title: GTA 6 Extended Gameplay Look Coming: Nearly 30 Minutes on PS5
description: Rockstar Games is set to reveal nearly 30 minutes of GTA 6 gameplay captured on PS5, giving fans their very first proper look at the highly anticipated title.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Extended Gameplay Look Coming: Nearly 30 Minutes on PS5

The long wait for a deeper look at Rockstar Games' upcoming masterpiece is finally reaching a pivotal moment. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, Rockstar Games is set to lift the veil on GTA 6 in a matter of hours with an extended look at gameplay.

For a community that has spent years eagerly parsing every rumor and official teaser, this upcoming showcase represents a major milestone. While a series of leaked clips have made the rounds over the last few days, this official deep dive—clocking in at nearly 30 minutes of gameplay captured directly on the PS5—will be the first proper glimpse at the game in action. For anybody interested in the future of open-world gaming, this is going to be essential viewing.

### A True Test for Current-Gen Hardware

The confirmation that this extended footage was captured on PS5 adds an extra layer of excitement for console players. It gives us a direct indication of how the hardware handles Rockstar's ambition, offering a realistic baseline for the visual fidelity, dense urban environments, and complex system interactions that the franchise is famous for. As the hours tick down, anticipation across the global gaming community has reached a fever pitch.

## Editor's Take

After months of speculation and scattered leaks, a 30-minute official gameplay walkthrough on PS5 is the absolute best way for Rockstar Games to set the record straight. It demonstrates immense confidence in their product and gives players the substantial look they've been craving. This is shaping up to be a defining moment for the industry, and it is definitely a presentation you cannot afford to miss.
